premises.text: Developer toil from software complexity wastes large amounts of time and drives unhappiness and attrition
premises.evidence_span: developers spend half their week in toil

premises.text: AppMap delivers personal runtime observability inside the code editor as developers write code, including across data stores and services
premises.evidence_span: see the behavior of their software as they write code

premises.text: Automatic analysis alerts on performance and security issues found in runtime behavior while coding
premises.evidence_span: automatically analyzes this information to find issues why developers work, and it alerts them if it finds a problem

premises.text: Deep language/framework integration and open source enable adoption across communities; maps are shareable for collaboration
premises.evidence_span: AppMap is open source to integrate with new languages and new communities

premises.text: Free for individuals, students, and open-source projects, with partnership path to accelerate other developer tools from inside the editor
premises.evidence_span: AppMap is free for individuals, students, and open source projects

value.text: Reduce developer toil and ship more performant, secure, and reliable code faster
value.evidence_span: reduce toil and ship more performant, secure, and reliable code faster

causal_links.evidence_span: Toil robs 25 million developers of the joy of coding
personal observability, performance, and security analysis to developers when they work to reduce toil

notes: Performance and security demo findings treated as examples of P3 analysis, not separate premises. Marketplace ratings and Postman partnership treated as traction/GTM evidence supporting P5. Incumbent DAST/APM disruption framed as market opportunity, not premise.
